notes.title: STUCK IN TUTORIAL BUG FIXED
notes.content:
what a blunder. I gave access to 50 people and didn't realize there was a bug that didn't let people go though the tutorial.

and I STILL NEED THE ENTRIES, that only start counting from stage 1!

I apologize for the inconvenience, the bug now should be fixed and you all should be able to test up to stage 10 (and endless).

Thank you for your patience, and please update the game and give it another try, I still don't have enough leaderboard entries because of this bug =/

notes.title: Death animations fixed for Playtest build!
notes.content:
